title: Chapter 953
text:
The battle turned into a one-sided beating. The miserable state of Heber being beaten up by the Mechanical Deity appeared in every pair of eyes. No one knew when this beating would stop.

Some people could not bear to watch and looked away. However, they could not help but look back.

It was rare to see a Beyond Grade A in such a sorry state. This was very precious video footage, and not many people were willing to waste the opportunity to watch it live. It would be something they could brag about in the future.

The people of the Bloodshed Land watched as their respected Tyrant was beaten up by Black Star. Their eyes were about to pop out of their sockets, and a sense of humiliation and anger rose in their hearts. They almost could not help but want to help.

However, they knew very well that even Heber was not Black Star's match. If they went up, they would only be sending themselves to their deaths. Not only would they not be of any use, but they would also ruin the fairness of this battle and make others look down on the Bloodshed Land.

Furthermore, the Tyrant himself would not forgive others for interfering in his battle.

Therefore, even though they were trembling in anger, they could only watch as their boss was beaten up by Black Star.

Bang!

Wrothers's facial muscles twitched, and he smashed the metal cabin wall with a slap. His entire body was trembling, and he suppressed his urge to attack.

"Tyrant …" Joad clenched his teeth and felt humiliated.

Their boss was beaten up by someone else, and they also felt ashamed.

On the other side, the many Beyond Grade As of the three Universal Civilizations were also watching the battle through the live broadcast.

After the battle of Planet Lighthouse, the Beyond Grade A circle had already acknowledged Black Star's strength. Most of the Beyond Grade As thought that Black Star would win, but they could guess the result but not the process.

In their minds, Heber would at least be able to cause some trouble for Black Star and get rid of more than half of his mechanical army. However, they did not expect that in reality, Heber would not even have the slightest chance of winning. Black Star completely controlled the battle.

"He's actually in such a sorry state. What an ugly loss." Ravenlaude shook his head.

"Black Star is really a scary guy. I feel that Heber is already very strong for being able to last this long. If I were there …" Beyoni could not help but put himself in the shoes of Black Star. Thinking of the result, he could not help but shiver.

Seriously, why did I have to scare myself? Black Star and I are good friends, good friends …

"About this, I believe that you and Dylan will have a lot of common topics," Milizzle...

Viru, on the other hand, was a little sad. "Sigh, after this battle, the Tyrant's reputation will be gone."

As a Martial Artist, when he saw Heber being beaten into such a miserable state, he could empathize with him and grieve for his friend.

These Beyond Grade A allies of the advanced civilizations all knew what Black Star could use the Mechanical Deity. It meant that he had already stepped into the peak Beyond Grade A level. Logically speaking, it was not embarrassing for Heber to be defeated by Black Star. However, the Tyrant's actions against Black Star in the past became the source of the backlash.

The grudges between the two of them made it difficult for Heber to back down. Once he failed, he would be pulled down from the altar. Not to mention, he was beaten up so badly.

Not only the dynasty's allies, but the Beyond Grade As of Radiance and Ethereal were also discussing Black Star in their own channels. Han Xiao's performance made all the Beyond Grade As tremble.

While they were discussing, the Mechanical Deity suddenly stopped.

Everyone's eyes sparkled.

"Oh, there's a result!"

…

An irresistible force came from the palm of the Mechanical Deity, and Heber was sent flying again, smashing through the asteroids along the way. His momentum gradually came to a stop, and he finally crashed into a huge continental plate fragment. His entire body was imprinted on it, leaving a human-shaped crater.

Blood blurred his vision. Heber's trembling hands grabbed the edge of the crater and pulled himself out. There was not a single part of his body that did not hurt, and he was covered in blood. He did not know how many bones and tendons were shattered. He could feel the terrible state of his body. His organs had almost turned into a pile of mush, and his extremely tired cells were barely able to repair themselves.

The Pugilist flames on Heber's body were like a candle in the wind, flickering and extremely dim, as if they could be extinguished at any time.

He clenched his teeth tightly, wanting to summon his strength again. However, a sense of powerlessness ran through his entire body like an electric current, and he did not even have the last drop of strength left.

Looking up, the Mechanical Deity did not continue to chase him but only looked at him from afar.

"Come on!" Heber wanted to roar, but he could not make a sound in the vacuum, so he could only move his mouth.

At this time, the Mechanical Deity disintegrated on its own, and the Lord's Avatar popped out. The Lord's Avatar slowly floated in front of Heber, staring at this guy who did not have a single piece of intact flesh on his body. It released a gas to surround the two of them, and at the same time, it opened the wide area communication channel.

"It's over. You no longer have the strength to fight." Han Xiao's voice sounded in the wide area communication channel, reaching the ears of everyone present.

"This injury is just a scratch for me. I can still fight you for an entire day!"

Heber's eyes were bloodshot. Ignoring the fact that his body was already at the end of its flight, he dragged his broken arm and punched the Lord's Avatar.

Pa!

The punch was easily blocked, and there was not even a tenth of his strength left.

Han Xiao took a deep breath and said coldly, "Admit defeat. You've already lost."

In the combat information, Heber did not have much health left, and there were debuffs all over his body. If this continued, he would definitely die.

Han Xiao's goal had already been achieved. There was a bottom line to everything. The dynasty did not interfere in the battle because they knew that he had a sense of propriety and would not allow an ally to die in the hands of another ally.

Going too far was not worth it. There was no need to cause trouble for the dynasty's upper echelons and other allies just because of a single Tyrant, which would affect their future development.

The current Tyrant was no longer qualified for him to eliminate him at all costs.

"Admit defeat? There's no such word in my dictionary! I don't need your pity! "

Heber roared and was about to continue attacking.

The next moment, mechanical imprisonment devices flew over and locked Heber's entire body, leaving only his head exposed.

Ka ka ka!

Heber struggled with all his might, but in his current state, he could not break free from these devices.

"Stop lying to yourself. You've already lost. You should know how serious your injuries are."

Han Xiao's tone sank.

Heber did not reply. He only glared at Han Xiao, the unwillingness and anger in his eyes almost solidifying.

Han Xiao glanced at him and slowly said, "Don't worry.

We're all allies of the dynasty. I'll spare your life. "

Hearing this, Heber's mind buzzed, and he felt an unprecedented sense of humiliation!

He had only managed to escape because of this identity. It was as if someone had given him his life. To him, this was a huge humiliation and torture.

He felt that his dignity and pride had been trampled under Han Xiao's feet, and he was so angry that he almost went crazy.

At this moment, Han Xiao suddenly had a thought and retreated a short distance.

Swoosh swoosh swoosh!

Wrothers and the other Vanguard Officials flew over like shooting stars, blocking in front of the Tyrant and protecting Heber behind them.

"We've lost …" Wrothers said with great difficulty. He then clenched his teeth and said, "But if you still want to do anything to His Excellency Tyrant, you'll have to step over our dead bodies!"

The many Vanguard Officials responded with a roar, their faces filled with vigilance. Some of them were ready to die, while others were hesitant.

"What are you doing? Get out of my way! " Heber was enraged. He had always been the one to protect others. When had he ever been protected by his subordinates? He only felt embarrassed and humiliated.

If I've lost, so be it. I'm a Beyond Grade A. Why would I need the protection of you Calamity Grades?

"No!" Wrothers did not even turn his head. His tone was firm, and this was the first time he had disobeyed the Tyrant's order.

Looking at the backs of the Vanguard Officials, Heber was a little stunned.

He had always viewed his subordinates as expendable items. This scene made him feel complicated, and he remained silent.

In the distance, Joad pursed his lips and looked around. He could see the confusion and conflict in the eyes of many Bloodshed Land members. He knew very well that the Tyrant's defeat had shaken many people's belief in working for the Bloodshed Land.

Many people joined a Beyond Grade A organization for a better future. The status of a Beyond Grade A was the source of cohesion. Therefore, when the leader of the organization was defeated, some people who pursued benefits might switch to another organization.

"I wonder how many people will leave because of this …" Joad sighed.

They might not join the Black Star Corps, but there would definitely be people who would leave the Bloodshed Land.

This scene also fell into the eyes of all the spectators. The Bloodshed Land had been growing rapidly recently, and they did not expect to receive such a heavy blow today.

Seeing the arrogant Tyrant and Bloodshed Land fall into such a sorry state, everyone felt extremely miserable. Some of them could not help but feel pity for them.

Han Xiao ignored these Vanguard Officials and glanced at Heber, who was silent with a defeated expression.

"Let's settle the old scores between us for now."

As soon as he said that, Han Xiao did not care about Heber's reaction. He retracted his gaze, turned around, and flew toward the Palace of Hidden Spells in front of everyone.

This was also a signal to everyone that the battle was over.

As the winner, Han Xiao did not need to say anything else, nor did he need to continue chasing after the Tyrant. That would make him seem ungenerous.

After winning this battle, his goal had been achieved. Everything else would happen naturally, and he did not need to do anything.

Seeing this, the surrounding spaceships all made way and watched as Han Xiao disappeared into the Palace of Hidden Spells.

Everyone present knew that from this moment onward, the strongest person in the Shattered Star Ring had been born!

…

"Sigh, we lost as expected."

In the Bloodshed Land fleet, Sorokin's avatar sighed.

After this battle, Black Star had completely solidified the position of the Black Star Corps as the overlord of the Shattered Star Ring. Even if the Bloodshed Land could continue to compete in terms of business, they would still be lacking in the end.

"The difficulty of the plan has increased …" Sorokin was helpless.

The dynasty's employer could not stop the battle, which made Sorokin a little depressed.

However, he did not completely rely on them. No matter what, he was just a financial group and did not have absolute confidence in interfering with the decisions of a Universal Civilization.

Glancing at Heber, who was being supported by the Vanguard Officials, Sorokin clicked his tongue.

He did not know how long it would take for the Tyrant to recover from his mental state. This might affect the cooperation between the two sides.

"Sigh, the situation has become troublesome again."

Sorokin's eyes flickered.

"A Beyond Grade A who builds fame will encounter such a calamity sooner or later. Fame is both an influence and a shackle to the Beyond Grade As … Luckily, I'm not as stupid as the Tyrant and have foresight.

Only by abandoning the shackles of the Beyond Grade A identity, not relying on any fame or battle records, and abandoning all of the past can one truly live like a fish in water, free and unrestrained.

If he had the choice, he would not accept the battle at all.

Unfortunately, the Tyrant was dragged down by his reputation and made a foolish choice. He did not even realize that he was shackled. Poor guy … Sorokin shook his head.

…

At the same time, the Lord's Avatar stepped into the Palace of Hidden Spells and met with Austin.

Han Xiao summoned a mechanical throne, sat down, and looked around.

"You still like to join in the fun. Has the Palace of Hidden Spells been repaired?"

"It was repaired long ago."

After chatting for a while, Austin teased him.

"Hehe, from today onward, you're the chief Beyond Grade A of the Shattered Star Ring. What do you think?"

"Nope."

Han Xiao shrugged and chuckled. "Actually, I've been the chief for a long time. All I lacked was a title."

"You're really not polite." Austin chuckled and did not deny it.

He knew that he was not Han Xiao's match. Sisko had suffered before, Ames and Black Star were on the same side, and now, even Heber had been defeated. Black Star had officially become the strongest person in this Star Field and the main representative of the Red Empire in the Shattered Star Ring.

After seeing his old friend and chatting for a while, Han Xiao bade farewell and controlled the Lord's Avatar to bring the mechanical army back to the battleship. After setting the return route, he deactivated [Lord's Descent].

The next moment, his consciousness was pulled out and returned to his main body in the dynasty.

The vision of the Lord's Avatar disappeared. Han Xiao opened his eyes and saw the scene in his room.

After sitting in silence for a while, Han Xiao slowly exhaled.

He had temporarily destroyed Ty-Ty's mentality, and the expansion of the Bloodshed Land would definitely be affected. The pressure on him could be reduced slightly.

Today, he finally got his revenge for being bullied back then. Han Xiao could finally vent his anger.

The belief of a Beyond Grade A was not so easily shaken. The Tyrant would accept reality sooner or later and recover his mentality.

However, he did not have to worry about the Tyrant in the short term.

Standing up and stretching, Han Xiao opened the door and walked straight to the cabin hall. All the officers on the ship were watching the live broadcast of the battle.

The Tyrant's mission was already completed, and he could draw the reward at any time. The next step was to do the necessary procedures before drawing the ability.

Fu Ding touched it and turned it into a motorcycle!

…

(A new month has begun. Begging for monthly votes.)
